events.event: The Mahkamah Agung (case 742 K/TUN/2026) granted Subhan's cassation and declared the SMA-equivalency certificate (suket) used by Gibran Rakabuming Raka for the 2024 election void by law, ordering Kemendikdasmen's suket revoked, citing the MK ruling of 5 Oct 2026 as a known fact.
events.key_numbers: Case 742 K/TUN/2026 · ruling copy dated 10 Nov 2026 · MK ruling 01/PHPU.PRES-XXIV/2026 of 5 Oct 2026
events.why_it_matters: A final court ruling now voids the document behind the Vice President's candidacy, opening a constitutional question for the whole country.
events.spreading_evidence: Top detik/CNN Indonesia headlines 10 Nov; many outlets

events.event: Mensesneg Prasetyo Hadi said VP Gibran told President Prabowo in a roughly 2.5-hour morning meeting that he intended to resign over the MK and MA rulings; Prasetyo denied Prabowo rejected it and said Prabowo advised him to keep fighting at PTUN, while Gibran asked for a chance to prove his documents there.
events.key_numbers: ~2.5 hour meeting (CNN) / ~2 hours (other report) · 10 Nov 2026 · Gibran did not himself state he would resign
events.why_it_matters: A sitting Vice President reportedly weighing resignation is a rare, first-of-its-kind moment for Indonesian politics.
events.spreading_evidence: Lead item across detik, CNN Indonesia, Tempo, Suara 10 Nov

events.event: Menko Kumham Yusril Ihza Mahendra said Gibran's plan to prove his diploma at PTUN is pointless because the MA ruling is final on the same subject matter, that Gibran was not a party so cannot appeal, and that the PTUN case by Mercy and Denny Indrayana may be dropped; he differs from Prasetyo's account of a PK at the MK.
events.key_numbers: MK and MA rulings both final · Kemendikdasmen expected not to file PK
events.why_it_matters: Two senior government voices disagree on whether Gibran has any legal route left.

events.event: DPR members from PKS (Mardani Ali Sera first signatory) and other factions began signing a Hak Menyatakan Pendapat (HMP) proposal on VP Gibran; CNN reports 50 members from six factions submitted it, while detik counted 12 signatures early that morning.
events.key_numbers: 50 members, 6 factions (CNN, afternoon) · 12 visible signatures, 'more than 25' per Mardani (detik, 10:06 WIB)
events.why_it_matters: It is the first formal step toward the DPR taking a stance on removing a Vice President.

events.event: Party positions on Gibran: PDIP urges him to resign or face impeachment, Golkar's Sarmuji says the DPR can use HMP, NasDem's Hermawi Taslim says resignation or replacement is fine if constitutional; DPR deputy speaker Dasco says it is still informal cross-faction talk awaiting the official MA ruling copy.
events.key_numbers: No seat or vote thresholds stated in the sources
events.why_it_matters: Shows which big parties are leaning toward removal and which want a constitutional process.

events.event: Puan Maharani opened DPR Masa Persidangan II 2026-2027 (10 Nov to 17 Dec) in a plenary without factional interruptions, setting four priority bills and 12 oversight issues including the presidential wiretapping case and karhutla.
events.key_numbers: 403 members present (Kompas/Katadata; detik says 414) · 10 Nov-17 Dec 2026 · 4 priority bills: RUU LLAJ, Hak Cipta, Koperasi, Perampasan Aset · 12 oversight issues
events.why_it_matters: It sets which laws, including the long-stalled Asset Forfeiture bill, the DPR will tackle in the next five weeks.

events.event: Kompolnas commissioner Choirul Anam urged Polri to run the presidential wiretapping case transparently, saying public information is conflicting and that victims include others besides Prabowo; the suspects remain four police generals.
events.key_numbers: 4 suspects (Listyo Sigit, Ahrie Sonta Nasution, Eko Hadi Santoso, Slamet Uliandi) · Pasal 258 and 332 KUHP, Pasal 32(1) UU ITE · up to 10 years
events.why_it_matters: Even the police watchdog says the public cannot tell fact from rumour in a case touching the President.

events.event: Jaksa KPK asked the Jakarta Tipikor panel to reject ex-Deputy Minister Silmy Karim's exception, and KPK again summoned nine private-sector witnesses in the disaster-fund (BNPB) case.
events.why_it_matters: Ongoing graft trials show whether big cases reach verdicts.

gaps: Exact MA panel, deadline for Kemendikdasmen to revoke suket, and whether Gibran formally resigned were not verified (Kompas/Tempo pages robots-blocked).
HMP legal thresholds and conflicting signature counts (12/25+/50) not reconciled.
